app-templates.message:
refactor: the questions move to runtime/shared/questions

## Intent

The quiz should show content blocks of the explainer. Today the explainer takes its exercises from the quiz; if the quiz then took blocks from the explainer, the two archetypes would depend on each other. Both should build on a neutral library instead.

## Key changes

- runtime/shared/questions holds the six question types: types and checker, schema, validation, rendering, the engine (startQuestion), the end-to-end helpers and the texts.
- The quiz keeps only its bank, page, order and score. The explainer imports nothing from the quiz.
- New package paths: @lernapps/app-templates/questions, /questions/engine, /questions/e2e, the question schema and its messages. The old public paths re-export what they exported; the quiz's schema carries the same question definitions, and a script keeps them equal.
- A new architecture test fails on an import between archetypes, an import of an archetype from runtime/shared, a public path without a file, and a built path without an entry of the build. The existing imports of interactive from the explainer are listed as known exceptions.
- Behaviour is unchanged; the architecture documents and a decision record the new building block.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The question texts moved out of quiz/messages/*.json; code that imports those files directly sees only the quiz page's texts.

app-templates.message:
refactor: interactive no longer imports the explainer

## Intent

The interactive archetype still imported loading, Markdown and the component checks from the explainer, the same kind of coupling as before. No archetype should import another, without exceptions.

## Key changes

- What both archetypes use alike moves to runtime/shared: reading YAML with line positions and reporting problems with file, line and path; schema errors as problems; the checks of the texts; restricted Markdown and formulas; the checks of the code of Vue components (no network, no code from strings, imports, browser globals).
- The messages that only fit the explainer's blocks stay in the explainer and are passed in as describe. The explainer keeps its own scope and exercise contract for components.
- One HTML escape function instead of six copies.
- The architecture test has no exceptions left. Comments in the explainer say "the question types" where they mean the shared questions.
